name: Luna
source: An adult Rabbit Girl and the Empress of her clan, Luna is well aware of her position and dignity and doesn't hesitate to remind the 'lesser people' of it at every opportunity. However, her dignity casts a dark shadow and who knows what sinister secrets may lurk within it…
